page.title: Settings
page.intro: Your profile, {clinic, select, true {clinic details} other {practice details}}, account type, integrations, intake templates and plan.

subscription.ok: Subscription confirmed. Your plan will update in a moment.
subscription.simulada: Plan activated in test mode (no charge).
subscription.erro: Couldn't open checkout. Check the Stripe keys and try again.
subscription.sem-permissao: Only the practice owner can change the plan.

google.ok: Google connected. Upcoming online sessions with Meet are created on your calendar.
google.desconectado: Google disconnected. Salutti's access to your calendar was revoked.
google.escopo: The Google Calendar permission wasn't checked. Connect again and keep the option to view and edit events checked.
google.negado: Connection canceled in Google. Nothing was changed.
google.indisponivel: The Google connection isn't enabled in Salutti yet.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.description: Applies to every account you access. Your birthday shows on the dashboard.
profile.photoHint: Shows in the menu and, if you choose, in place of the Salutti logo.
profile.name: Name
profile.birthdayHint: Used only for the reminder on the team dashboard.
profile.showPatientBirthdays: Show my patients' birthdays on the dashboard
profile.showPatientBirthdaysHint: In a clinic, only the patients you see. Remembering the date is up to you and your therapeutic frame.

accountType.title: Account type
accountType.ownerOnly: Only the account owner can change the type.
accountType.toAutonomo: Switch to an independent professional account: the account will have one active professional.
accountType.toClinic: Switch to clinic: lets you add several professionals and work as a team.
accountType.keeps: Patients, schedule, records and finances stay as they are.
accountType.recordsWarning: Records of deactivated professionals stay in this account and come under your management. Follow the retention period set by your licensing board (in Brazil, at least 5 years, CFP Res. 001/2009). Agree with whoever provided care before switching.
accountType.blockerProfessionals: there are {count} active professionals (deactivate the others and keep only one)
accountType.blockerMembers: there are {count} users with clinical or management access (front desk and finance can stay; ask support to remove the others)

workspace.title: {clinic, select, true {Clinic details} other {Practice details}}
workspace.description: Used on invoices, TISS forms and messages to patients. Short address: {slug} · Plan
workspace.name: {clinic, select, true {Clinic name} other {Practice name}}
workspace.cnpjOptional: CNPJ (if you operate as a company)
workspace.menuTop: At the top of the menu
workspace.brandPhoto: Profile photo of the current user
workspace.bannerHint: Wide image (logo or banner), up to 1200×400. Without an uploaded banner, the Salutti logo shows.
workspace.readOnly: Only the owner or an admin can change these details.

google.description: Each session's Meet link is created in the Google account of the professional providing care: only that person controls who joins the room. Each professional connects their own account; without a connection, the session has no link.
google.otherAccount: The connected Google account ({email}) is different from your Salutti email. Make sure it's really yours: your session meetings live there.
google.privacy: The event is private, has no guests and uses the generic title “Sessão · Salutti” (always in Portuguese): the patient's name never goes to Google.
google.tipRecording: Keep Meet recording, transcription and automatic notes turned off during sessions.
google.tipEpsi: In Brazil, list Google Meet as your platform in the e-Psi registry (CFP Res. 11/2018); elsewhere, follow your licensing board. Tell the patient as well.
google.tipWorkspace: Prefer a Google Workspace account with a data processing agreement over a personal Gmail.
google.permissionHint: On the Google screen, keep the permission to view and edit calendar events checked. Salutti only creates the session event with the Meet link.
google.notEnabled: The Google connection isn't enabled in Salutti yet. Meanwhile, online sessions get a simulated link.

certificate.title: A1 certificate (ICP-Brasil)
certificate.hint: The .pfx file is stored encrypted, and you get a notice 30 days before it expires.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Sandbox integrations run on simulated data until you enter the real key.

templates.title: Intake templates
templates.description: {count}. Add more from the library below; editing questions is still done in Prisma Studio (npx prisma studio).

plan.title: Salutti plan
plan.stripeTest: · Stripe in test mode: activation is simulated
plan.ownerOnly: Only the practice owner can change the plan.

subscription.title: Choose a plan to continue
subscription.intro: This practice's free trial has ended (or the subscription was cancelled). Your data is still stored: subscribe to a plan to use the schedule, records and finances again.
subscription.pending: Payment received. Access is restored as soon as Stripe confirms, in a moment: refresh the page.
subscription.plansOwner: Billing is recurring and you can cancel anytime in Settings.
subscription.plansMember: Only the practice owner can subscribe. Let them know.
subscription.dataDescription: Even without a plan, you can export patient data and handle data protection requests.

team.title: Professionals
team.introAutonomo: Independent professional account: the professional profile used on sessions, receipts and forms.
team.introClinic: Includes psychoanalysts, therapists and other professions without a board license.
team.autonomoLimit: An independent professional account has one active professional. To build a team, switch to clinic in Settings.
team.noPermission: Only the owner or an admin can manage professionals.
team.listClinic: Team · {count, plural, one {# professional} other {# professionals}}
team.name: Name
team.empty: No professionals yet. Add the first one using the form next to this list.
team.autonomoDescription: This account has one active professional. To add other people and work as a team, switch the account type to clinic. Patients, schedule and finances stay as they are.
team.formDescription: For psychoanalysts and therapists, check “no board license”.
team.userAccessHint: The Google Meet link for sessions is created in this person's Google account.

errors.invalid: Check the name, professional type and hourly rate.
errors.userLink: This user can't be linked (not on the team or already has an active profile).

lgpd.title: LGPD and compliance
lgpd.intro: You are the data controller and Salutti is the processor. Legal bases used: consent, health protection, contract performance and legal obligation.
lgpd.rightsTitle: The 9 data subject rights (LGPD art. 18, Brazilian law)
lgpd.rightsDescription: Each right is handled by the actions below, including data export.

rights.r6: Deletion of data processed with consent

lgpd.exerciseDescription: Export the data as JSON, anonymize it (keeps only aggregate data) or delete it (respecting the legal retention period).
lgpd.auditDescription: Immutable records of who did what and when.
lgpd.platformContact: Questions about how Salutti, as data processor, handles platform data:

communication.title: Communication
communication.intro: Messages sent via WhatsApp with approved templates: reminders, charges and receipts.
communication.recentDescription: Session reminders, charges, receipts and welcome messages.
communication.empty: No messages sent yet. Session reminders show up here.

access.linkHint: Only someone signing in with the invited email can use this link.

errors.noPermission: Only the owner or an admin manages access.

errors.adminOnlyOwner: Only the account owner can invite admins.
